passive.name: Steady
passive.text: End your turn with energy unspent: +1 Aim (max 3). An arrow spends all Aim for +4 power each.

cards.name: NOCK
cards.text: Draw 1. Steady counts this turn even with no energy left.

cards.name: LONG SHOT
cards.text: Arrow, power 12, +5 per Aim instead of +4, ignores guard.

passive.name: Drowsy
passive.text: Spores on the foe (max 3). At three it dozes through its next action, once a fight; after that, three spores soften its next card by a third. In a raid: always the softening.

cards.name: SOFT LANDING
cards.text: Heal 5 now and 5 at the start of each of your next two turns.

b.name: SLOW LANDING
b.text: Heal 3 now, 4 a turn over three turns.

passive.name: Dim
passive.text: She starts each fight with 1 Dusk; a still turn: +1 Dusk (max 3). Each Dusk is spent on the foe's next damaging card, which deals a third less (one Dusk a hit).

cards.name: SHUTTER
cards.text: Guard (a still turn, so Dim banks a Dusk).

cards.name: NIGHT FALLS
cards.text: Power 6 and 6 per Dusk, spending all, ignores guard.

passive.name: Counting Sheep
passive.text: A still turn: a sheep hops into the fold (max 3). At the start of your next turn each sheep adds a card to your hand (never energy).

cards.name: STAMPEDE
cards.text: Power 7, +3 per other card in your hand.

passive.name: Bothy
passive.text: A still turn banks Warmth (max 3). Once a fight, a blow that would knock her out finds her curled up at 1 HP, healed 3 per Warmth.

passive.name: Tide
passive.text: His turns alternate, ebb then flow. On ebb his damaging cards soak (the foe's next card costs 1 more; if it cannot pay, it holds that card back). On flow they splash: +2 power.

cards.name: UNDERTOW
cards.text: Power 7; on ebb also -1 energy to the foe.

passive.name: Bedrock
passive.text: His guard halves two hits, not one.

cards.name: SHOULDER CHARGE
cards.text: Power 10; while guarded +8 and the guard is spent.

cards.name: STANDING STONE
cards.text: Power 8; while guarded +1 energy next turn.

passive.name: A Minute Slow
passive.text: Instead of playing a card, set it on the clock: pay its cost now; it lands at the start of your next turn with +3 (power or heal). One card on the clock.

cards.name: STATION BELL
cards.text: Power 10, ignores guard (+3 from the clock).

passive.name: Seep
passive.text: A still turn adds a drop to her flask (max 3). Pouring is not a still turn. She never guards.

cards.name: POUR
cards.text: Heal 8 per drop, emptying the flask.

passive.name: Banked fire
passive.text: Heat +1 at the start of each of her turns (max 3); damaging cards +2 power per heat. When heat would pass 3 the bell tolls: she rests that turn, heals 12 and heat falls to 0.

cards.name: BELL TOLL
cards.text: Power 11 (+2 per heat), removes the foe's guard, +1 heat.

cards.name: FORGE REST
cards.text: Heat to 0, heal 5 per heat let go.

passive.name: Overgrow
passive.text: A still turn grows a layer (max 3): each adds +3 power to his damaging cards. A hit of 15 or more knocks the top layer off.

passive.name: Do Not Disturb
passive.text: After a still turn the foe's next trick (a card's extra effect: a skip, a soak, energy, ignoring guard, spores) is muted; after two still turns in a row it is reflected onto the foe instead, once a fight.

cards.name: RETURN TO SENDER
cards.text: Power 13, +6 if she muted or reflected a trick this fight.

passive.name: Sleep Cycle
passive.text: A two-stage dial turns each turn: deep heals 2 at the start of the turn; dream gives your next damaging card +2 power. A still turn holds the stage.

passive.name: Dream
passive.text: Once a fight, use your familiar's rested special before it is charged, at half its full strength, without spending the real pips. Never the strongest.

cards.name: STARDUST
cards.text: Play the last card you played again at half strength.

restedSpecials.name: SLEEP IT OFF
restedSpecials.text: Heal 3 per pip; with three pips, guard too.

restedSpecials.name: SECOND WIND
restedSpecials.text: +1 energy per pip (energy still caps at 3); with three pips, draw 1.

restedSpecials.name: IN THE ZONE
restedSpecials.text: Your next damaging card this turn: +1 power per pip, ignores guard.
